## `raylib::Mesh`

[source](raylib.goose#L136-L153)

```goose
struct Mesh {
    vertex_count: i32, // Number of vertices stored in arrays
    triangle_count: i32, // Number of triangles stored (indexed or not)
    vertices: u64, // Vertex position (XYZ - 3 components per vertex) (shader-location = 0)
    texcoords: u64, // Vertex texture coordinates (UV - 2 components per vertex) (shader-location = 1)
    texcoords2: u64, // Vertex texture second coordinates (UV - 2 components per vertex) (shader-location = 5)
    normals: u64, // Vertex normals (XYZ - 3 components per vertex) (shader-location = 2)
    tangents: u64, // Vertex tangents (XYZW - 4 components per vertex) (shader-location = 4)
    colors: u64, // Vertex colors (RGBA - 4 components per vertex) (shader-location = 3)
    indices: u64, // Vertex indices (in case vertex data comes indexed)
    bone_count: i32, // Number of bones (MAX: 256 bones)
    bone_indices: u64, // Vertex bone indices, up to 4 bones influence by vertex (skinning) (shader-location = 6)
    bone_weights: u64, // Vertex bone weight, up to 4 bones influence by vertex (skinning) (shader-location = 7)
    anim_vertices: u64, // Animated vertex positions (after bones transformations)
    anim_normals: u64, // Animated normals (after bones transformations)
    vao_id: u32, // OpenGL Vertex Array Object id
    vbo_id: u64, // OpenGL Vertex Buffer Objects id (default vertex data)
}
```

Mesh, vertex data and vao/vbo
